competitorDescription: v0 by Vercel turns a prompt into a working web app or component, with visual editing and GitHub sync. Plans are Free, Plus ($30/user/mo), Business ($100/user/mo) and Enterprise.
positioning: Atai follows the business lifecycle — IDEA → BUILD → LAUNCH → MANAGE → GROW → SCALE. v0 is built around generating a front-end and deploying it to Vercel.
limitations: Plans, prices and entitlements on both sides change regularly. Every row below was checked on 2026-11-15 against the source linked in that row — re-verify before you decide.

rows.atai: Plan, build, launch, manage, grow and scale a business from one platform.
rows.competitor: Generate web apps and UI components from a prompt, then deploy them to Vercel.

rows.atai: Covers the full lifecycle: business planning and offer development, building the app, launching it, then running finances, marketing and growth.
rows.competitor: Covers generating the app and deploying it.

rows.atai: Explorer (free), Starter ($89.99/mo or $989.89/yr), Growth ($199.99/mo or $2,199.89/yr), Scale ($499.99/mo or $5,499.89/yr) and Enterprise (custom).
rows.competitor: Free, Plus ($30 per user per month), Business ($100 per user per month) and Enterprise. The older Premium plan ($20/mo) is being sunset and is no longer available to new users.

rows.atai: Subscription plans with a monthly Atai Credit allowance; yearly plans are paid upfront for 12 months and still receive credits every month.
rows.competitor: Credits as a prepaid balance, plus $2 of daily login credits on Plus and Business; generations pause when the balance runs out.

rows.atai: Explorer: plan your business with the AI co-founder on 500 planning credits, with community support. Production launches are a paid-plan capability.
rows.competitor: Free access to v0, deploy apps to Vercel, edit visually with Design Mode, sync with GitHub and a 7 message/day limit.

rows.atai: Full application builds from Starter upward, with up to four production apps on Growth and unlimited on Scale.
rows.competitor: The core product — prompt to a working app, with visual Design Mode editing on top.

rows.atai: Starter and above: edit code in the editor or visually, download your source code and sync with GitHub. A custom domain of your own arrives with Growth.
rows.competitor: Sync with GitHub is included on the Free plan, and apps deploy to Vercel.

rows.atai: Specialist teams from Starter, expanded teams on Growth and premium teams with customization on Scale and Enterprise.
rows.competitor: Plus and Business add shared projects, a shared credit pool, centralized billing and team-wide usage analytics.

rows.atai: SLA-backed uptime and dedicated infrastructure from Enterprise.
rows.competitor: Business opts out of training by default and adds data opt-out; Enterprise adds SAML SSO, role-based access control and guaranteed support SLAs.

rows.atai: Growth adds direct support; Enterprise adds a dedicated account manager and white-glove onboarding.
rows.competitor: Enterprise includes priority access and guaranteed customer support SLAs.

rows.atai: Monthly plan credits expire at the end of the month they were issued; permanent top-up credits never expire, so heavy use moves you up a plan.
rows.competitor: Unused monthly credits roll over and expire after 65 days; daily login credits expire at the end of the day and do not accumulate.
